learning_outcomes.text: Model and solve problems related to the business system
Make decisions related to production management
Understand the international context of companies and their institutional framework

assessment_rules: For the ordinary call, a minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required for both the theoretical and practical blocks. The final theoretical grade is 0.65 times the T1 exam score. The final practical grade is 0.35 times the average of P1, P2, P3, and P4 practical exams. If all minimums are met, the final grade is the sum of theoretical and practical grades; otherwise, it is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. For the extraordinary call, a theoretical exam and a practical exam are given; a minimum of 4 points out of 10 is required for both. If minimums are met, the final grade is (0.65 x Theory) + (0.35 x Practicals); otherwise, it is the minimum of the calculated grade and 4.0. Students with differentiated evaluation will have a single individual practical test instead of the practical activities, while other conditions remain the same.
